subject: Cobalt upgrade report
fact: Base reported that Cobalt was live on mainnet, adding conditional transaction eligibility and extending B20 asset controls.
event_time_or_period: Mainnet activation reported as 2026-09-30; news report dated 2026-10-01.
date_basis: Secondary report date; primary announcement dated 2026-09-30
verification_note: Primary announcement predates the window. Included as an in-window news report, not an in-window activation. No chain-state audit.

subject: Public RPC service change
fact: Base announced removal of debug, trace and txpool namespaces from its public mainnet RPC, together with lower read limits; basic reads would remain available.
verification_note: Announcement of a service change. The saved API also contains a later completion update dated October 8; that update was not available on October 1.

subject: Japan DeFi Gateway development
fact: Uniswap Labs announced that SMBC Nikko and Nethermind were developing a Uniswap v4 trading venue for Japanese investors, with development support from Base, Uniswap Labs and Nyx Foundation.
verification_note: Development plan and named support relationships. The announcement does not establish a completed deployment on Base.

subject: V1 node snapshot retirement completed
fact: Base marked the retirement of V1 node snapshots as completed. The original notice scheduled the end of publication and availability of V1 snapshots for October 5.
verification_note: The completion update is the in-window publication. Original notice and scheduled date are preserved separately in the API evidence.

subject: Portable reputation on Base
fact: Base described Ethos contracts and an API that expose reputation signals to other applications. Ethos reported 863,683 reputation actions, 33.8 million scored X accounts and USD 7.22 million committed to vouching.
date_basis: Base Latest directory date; article has no exact publication time
verification_note: Company-reported totals, not independent counts. Actions are not unique users; scored accounts are not active users; USD vouching value varies with prices. No individual posts or interactions collected.

subject: Aave V4 Base market announcement
fact: Aave announced a Base V4 market with an Equities Hub and MAG7 Spoke, listing USDC plus AAPLc, AMZNc, GOOGLc, METAc, MSFTc, NVDAc and TSLAc.
event_time_or_period: Launch reported in the 2026-10-07 changelog entry.
verification_note: Publisher announcement verified. Exact deployment time, contracts and operational state were not independently checked.

subject: Mainnet proposal incident resolved
fact: Base reported a proposal stall that could delay withdrawals, then reported proposals resumed and subsequently closed the incident.
event_time_or_period: First notice 13:48:04.839Z; resumed notice 14:21:49.930Z; resolved notice 19:15:21.597Z on 2026-10-09.
date_basis: Resolution-update display_at; earlier updates retained separately
verification_note: Status communication times do not establish the true start or duration of the onchain failure. Bridge (Mainnet) is the affected component.

subject: Reported Base x402 activity
fact: Chainalysis reported more than 138 million x402 transactions on Base by the end of its 2026 reporting period.
verification_note: The original report supports the figure and reporting period. This is a vendor research assertion, not an October transaction count or an independently reproduced count.

subject: Spending from an earning strategy
fact: Base described Tuyo card and account services on Base, including spending USDC held in an Earn strategy. Tuyo reported more than 100,000 users across its app.
event_time_or_period: User figure as of 2026-10-14; card reach/pricing references dated 2026-09-24.
date_basis: Base Latest directory date; article has no exact publication time
verification_note: Tuyo-wide users are not Base active addresses. The page also reports 175 million potential card acceptance locations and a 0% USD card-spend fee; these are reach/pricing claims, not usage or all-service fees.

subject: Aero economic design announcement
fact: Aero described an exchange combining Aerodrome and Velodrome, with AERO staking, continuous allocation of liquidity rewards and pool-level reward caps linked to projected revenue.
event_time_or_period: Design published 2026-10-19 before the scheduled launch.
verification_note: Announced design. Performance, revenue projections and deployment success are not independently established.

subject: Sepolia Denim upgrade scheduled
fact: Base scheduled the Denim upgrade on Sepolia and instructed node operators to use base/base version 1.5.0 or later and remove the obsolete experimental validity-transactions flag.
verification_note: Sepolia testnet, not mainnet. A separate row records the later completion announcement.

subject: USDC remittance cost comparison
fact: Research commissioned by Coinbase estimated that a USD 200 remittance using USDC on Base cost about 86% less than a volume-weighted blend of traditional services.
event_time_or_period: World Bank remittance prices: Q3 2025; provider fee schedules: August 2026.
verification_note: Announcement checked in the browser after direct HTTP returned 403. Original PDF page 6 (printed page 5) confirms the comparison and periods. This is a modeled comparison, not a current universal fee saving.

subject: Aero launch announcement
fact: Aero announced a seven-network launch including Base, and an upgrade path for existing AERO, VELO and locked positions into the new token and staking system.
event_time_or_period: Scheduled launch 2026-10-22T00:00:00Z, equal to October 21 at 20:00 EDT.
verification_note: The displayed announcement date is inside the window; the scheduled UTC launch is exactly at the excluded end boundary. No in-window deployment claim is made.

subject: Sepolia Denim activation reported
fact: Base announced that Denim had activated on Sepolia and that its scheduled maintenance was complete.
verification_note: Testnet activation as reported by the operator. This publication follows the earlier scheduled-maintenance announcement.
